transcript.text: Alright everyone, thanks for gathering. As we prepare to finalize the format for Saturday's showcase and lock in the production schedule, I need to hear from each of your teams. Digital, labor, and artist teams — please report any constraints or issues that could affect the final format. I need to approve this before we release the schedule, so let's get everything on the table now.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a constraint from the digital side. This morning I reviewed the voting platform's updated terms during setup, and the platform cannot collect audience phone numbers. Voting must use anonymous QR tokens instead, and we'll need to update the audience-facing privacy notice accordingly. I haven't added this to the show brief yet because the vendor posted the update after the brief was circulated, but this directly affects the audience-voting segment.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I've got a constraint from the labor side. I received the applicable union bulletin and confirmed that the audience volunteer segment requires exactly 8 paid volunteers and a scheduled group rehearsal before the live recording. I hadn't entered this on the production board yet because the volunteer segment was still marked as provisional, but since we're finalizing the format now, this needs to be factored in.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a constraint from the artist side. After the draft was circulated, I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the headliner cannot appear live during the showcase. However, the agent has approved a prerecorded appearance to play at exactly 9:20 PM. I haven't revised the draft yet because the agent's confirmation came in after the last creative review, but this directly affects the headliner appearance segment — it will need to be a prerecorded playback rather than a live appearance.
transcript.speaker: A4

decisions.audience_vote_method: Anonymous QR tokens (no phone number collection); update audience-facing privacy notice accordingly

commitments.detail: Update the show brief and audience-facing privacy notice to reflect anonymous QR token voting with no phone number collection.
Add 8 paid volunteers and a scheduled group rehearsal for the volunteer segment to the production schedule.
Revise the show draft to change the headliner appearance from live to prerecorded playback scheduled at 9:20 PM.
